en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a steamship with two large smokestacks and lifeboats along the side, sailing in a harbor with piers and buildings visible in the background. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as a ship named "Isle of Thanet" in the channel at Calais. The layout, border, and printed caption suggest an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.
